purpose: Make the existing production source pack visible in a local P1C01 preview without mixing a runtime/config mutation into the active #200/#201 serialized train.

baseline_observation.interpretation: The repository intentionally generates ignored Content/Production locally. Without the production import pass, runtime builders resolve only fallbacks; Template_Default can also leave its white floor in the visible preview.

behavior: Require the UE4 editor to be closed before import.
Reuse the existing production import commandlet rather than inventing a second importer.
Verify that generated .uasset files exist under Content/Production after import.
Launch the project against /Engine/Maps/Entry in game mode so the engine Template_Default floor does not mask the generated Shire.
Do not change Config/DefaultEngine.ini in this tooling-only lane.

asset_policy.existing_obj_scope: Static/source fallback only; not evidence of animated production readiness.
asset_policy.production_textures: PNG/TGA only; new BMP production textures forbidden.
asset_policy.heavy_runtime_loading: Soft references plus FStreamableManager asynchronous loading.

playable_delivery_2026_10_10.reason: The historical tooling-only preview showed that Template_Default floor could mask the Shire. Separate owner-authorized delivery change updates actual game default, headless runtime, cooker and packaged startup to Entry.
